text:
alex: Quick question — where do I pull per-pool autoscaling graphs for dedicated pools? Trying to tune scale-up threshold for pool 'dedicated-eu-general' — current autoscale is too slow and we saw 95th latency spiking.

maria: Grafana has the panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pool-autoscale/pool-autoscale-overview?var-pool=dedicated-eu-general
Panels to check: "pool:cpu_utilization:avg", "pool:queue_latency_p95", "pool:scale_actions", "pool:pod_ready_ratio". Also look at the "Autoscaler decisions" row.

maria: Prometheus quick queries:
```
avg_over_time(pool_cpu_utilization{pool="dedicated-eu-general"}[5m])
sum(rate(pool_scale_events_total{pool="dedicated-eu-general"}[1m])) by (reason)
``` 

simon: Scaling decisions are emitted by autoscaler and logged to Loki (label app=autoscaler). Try:
```
{app="autoscaler", pool="dedicated-eu-general"} |= "scale up" | json | line_format "ts={{.ts}} event={{.event}} reason={{.reason}}" 
``` 
That shows why it waited (e.g., cooldown, pod startup). Also check pod startup times with `kube_pod_container_status_ready{namespace="dedicated-eu-general"}`

jess: The alert that usually trips here is `DedicatedPoolScalingDelayHigh`. It's defined in infra/alerts/dedicated_pools.yml — if you want to tune, open a PR and ping @jess for a quick review. Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/DEDICATED+Pool+Runbook

deploy-bot: autoscaler-controller: scale up event for pool=dedicated-eu-general target_replicas=24 -> reason=cpu:threshold breach :rocket:

alex: thanks — I'll try lowering the scale-up threshold from 80% -> 70% in a canary pool first and post results. If latency still jumps I'll open an alert tweak PR.

maria: FYI also check `pool:kv_cache_hit_rate` and `active_kv_cache_size` — cache warmup can delay scale effectiveness.

alex: noted, will report back in ~30m :thumbsup:
